issues.description: Default stories_dir points to data/stories, but the repo contains no story files, so extract/all is not reproducible from a clean checkout.
generate-stories requires an existing stories manifest to get topics, so it cannot bootstrap the missing dataset it is supposed to generate.
Story dataset coverage is skipped when data is missing, allowing the broken clean-checkout state to pass normal tests.
Runtime and dev dependencies are only lower-bounded, making model/runtime behavior non-reproducible across future torch/transformers/numpy releases.
requirements.txt duplicates unpinned dependencies instead of using a lock or constraints file for reproducible installs.
Config loading casts values but does not validate ranges or invariants, so invalid PCA targets, layer ranges, counts, or batch sizes fail later in obscure ways.
Story loading blindly reads configured files and accepts stripped content without checking existence, emptiness, length, or manifest consistency.
parse_story_block treats any preamble before the first <NEW STORY> delimiter as a real story, corrupting generated datasets from common LLM responses.
Story generation sends the API key to arbitrary api_base URLs and uses urlopen without a timeout, risking token leakage over HTTP and indefinite hangs.
Single-token or effectively empty inputs can produce L - s == 0 and crash activation averaging with division by zero.
all_token_activations materializes every token, layer, and hidden dimension in float32 before PCA, which can OOM on larger neutral corpora.
emotion_vectors produces NaNs when any configured emotion has zero loaded examples instead of failing with a clear validation error.
pca_components divides by total variance without handling zero-variance inputs, producing NaNs and arbitrary components.
Logit-lens markdown writes decoded tokens into a table without escaping pipes or newlines, so valid tokens can break the report format.
Generated egg-info metadata is checked into source control, creating stale packaging metadata risk.
Generated experiment outputs are checked in despite the input story dataset being absent, which obscures provenance and cleanup boundaries.
